paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : WMT15 De
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between average lagging and BLEU scores for different consistency models. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" and uses a linear scale from 0.0 to 10.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.0, 2.5, 5.0, 7.5, and 10.0. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and uses a linear scale from 18 to 29, with tick labels at intervals of 2.0. A purple, dashed line with square markers, labeled "Inconsistency-CE," begins at a BLEU score of approximately 18.8 at AL 0.0 and increases to approximately 26.3 at AL 10.0. A dark blue, solid line with square markers, labeled "Inconsistency-CE-MP," begins at approximately 19.3 at AL 0.0 and increases to approximately 26.8 at AL 10.0. A red, dashed line with star markers, labeled "Consistency-Bi," begins at approximately 22.2 at AL 0.0 and increases to approximately 28.2 at AL 10.0.
